title: Component gallery
description: Every common component in one place, with synthetic data. Shown in demo mode and in development only.

primaryAction.label: Try the primary action
primaryAction.done: The primary action ran. On a real list it opens the form for a new record.

sections.tableHint: Paging, sorting and filtering happen on the server. This page fakes the server in the browser.
sections.badgesHint: Labels that keep a demo honest, and show how sensitive a record is.
sections.piecesHint: Used inside tables and detail pages.
sections.formHint: Fields, server errors, drafts and the prompt before leaving. The save is faked in the browser: choose what the server answers, then press Save or Ctrl+S.
sections.listHint: The template every list is built on: filters, the action bar, Void with its reason, Export and Print, and the five status chips. New is left out here because N already runs this page's own primary action. The server is faked in the browser.

feedback.title: Amounts, messages and loading shapes
feedback.description: Every action ends with a message, with Undo where it can be undone. Loading shapes match the final layout.
